mapper.select: select c1.C_Name as wiUnitName, wi.Wi_Unit_Id as wiUnitId, wi.Wi_Unit_Contacts as wiUnitContacts, wi.Wi_Unit_Contacts_Tel as wiUnitContactsTel, wi.Wi_Order_No as wiOrderNo, wi.Wi_Sampling_Start_Date as wiSamplingStartDate, wi.Wi_Sampling_End_Date as wiSamplingEndDate, wi.Wi_Start_Date as wiStartDate, wi.Wi_End_Date as wiEndDate, pay.Con_Id as conId, mn.* from Con_Pay_Witness mn left join Con_Pay pay on pay.Pay_Id = mn.Pay_Id left join Me_Witness_Inspection wi on wi.Wi_Id = mn.Wi_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on wi.Wi_Unit_Id = c1.C_Id where pay.Con_Id = #{conId} and wi.Wi_State=7 order by mn.Pw_Sort ASC
